object Arithmetic {
  def f(a: Int, b: Int): Int = a + b - a * b / 2
  def g(a: Int): Int = a + 1
  def h(a: Long): Long = a - 1L
  def i(s: String): String = "x" + s + "y"
  def j(a: Int): Int = -a + -1
  def k(xs: Int*): Int = xs.sum
  def l(a: Int): Int = {
    var n = a
    n += 1
    n -= 1
    n
  }
  def m(a: Int): Int = if (a > 2) -1 else 3
}
